svg.title: parsePreferences full architecture
svg.desc: User prompt checks the completion cache first, returning immediately on a hit. On a miss, a query embedding cache is checked before calling Voyage via ai-provider; either way the vector goes to Atlas search via the vector package. Retrieval enriches the system prompt with few-shot examples, the LLM generates a completion via ai-provider, and a quality gate is checked in the domain layer. If it fails, the result still returns but nothing is stored. If it passes, a document embedding cache is checked before calling Voyage again, and the vector plus output is stored in Atlas via the vector package. A dashed feedback loop on the left shows the self-evolving mechanism: stored examples become available to future retrievals, growing the store from real usage over time.
svg.text: Purple = ai-provider · Teal = vector · Amber = decision · Gray = domain/start-end
Solid = within one request · Dashed = across requests over time
